title: Bed-Hold Nights Inside an Uncertified Lapse — Medicare Part A Charge Reductions
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage and Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.** A held night of the bed-hold leave booked for the lapse's block's service month is not a day the uncertified lapse reverses: the held nights that lie inside the reversal's span come off the lapse's days before the supplemental effective date, all of that overlap when its last day falls before the date, the overlap from its first day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first day and on or before its last, and none otherwise or when there is no such record.

The lapse is the uncertified-day reversal posted against the booked-days entry of the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block after the resident's original coinsurance charge for that block was posted; the lapse's block is that block. The held nights are read from the resident's Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records: the bed-hold leave booked for the same service month as the lapse's block, from its first to its last held day. The figure modified is the reversed days the reduction for reversed covered days counts before the supplemental effective date.

| Supplemental effective date compared with the held nights inside the lapse's span | Nights that come off |
|---|---|
| Falls after the last such night | The whole overlap |
| Falls after the first such night and on or before the last | The overlap from its first day up to the day before the date |
| Any other position | None |
| No bed-hold leave booked for the service month | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* the lapse spans the 17th to the 23rd and the bed-hold leave holds the 20th and 21st. Supplemental effective date the 26th: two nights come off. The 21st: one night (the 20th). The 18th: none.
